verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API overview tells developers to 'import the spec' into API tools like Postman, which implies a first-party machine-readable spec. It also offers a pre-built Postman collection. However, the evidence never names the format (e.g., OpenAPI) or a download location, so the depth of this capability is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit OpenAPI/format confirmation, documented download URL or versioning of the spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Import the spec into your favorite API tool, such as Postman, to start interacting with our new APIs right away.
Make test calls using Postman’s UI tool with our collection of pre-built API requests.
